# Contract: the generated workflow

Byte-exact layout of the file `rune ci github` writes. Two-space indentation, `\n` line
ends, a final line feed. `<...>` marks generated values.

```yaml
# Generated by rune ci github. Do not edit: change the Runefile, then run:
#   rune ci github <options> --write <roots>
name: rune
on:
  push:
    branches: ['<branch>']
  pull_request:
permissions:
  contents: read
defaults:                                  # only when the Runefile is below the repository root
  run:
    working-directory: '<dir>'
jobs:
  <job id>:
    name: '<label>'
    runs-on: <ubuntu-latest | macos-latest>
    needs: [<job id>, ...]                 # only when not empty
    steps:
      - name: Check out
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install rune <version>
        shell: bash
        run: |
          <install script, research R6>
      - name: Download outputs of <job id>  # one per transitive need with outputs
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: rune-<job id>
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/rune-ci/in/<NNNN>-<job id>
      - name: Cache key                     # [cache] tasks only
        id: key
        shell: bash
        run: rune ci run --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/rune-ci" --key -- <task> <args> >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - name: Restore cache                 # [cache] tasks only
        id: restore
        uses: actions/cache/restore@v4
        with:
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/rune-ci/bundle.tar
          key: ${{ steps.key.outputs.key }}
      - name: Run <label>
        shell: bash
        run: rune ci run --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/rune-ci" -- <task> <args>
      - name: Save cache                    # [cache] tasks only
        if: steps.restore.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        uses: actions/cache/save@v4
        with:
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/rune-ci/bundle.tar
          key: ${{ steps.key.outputs.key }}
      - name: Upload outputs                # tasks with [cache] outputs only
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: rune-<job id>
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/rune-ci/bundle.tar
          retention-days: 1
          if-no-files-found: error
          overwrite: true
```

Invariants (tested on every golden file):

- `permissions` has exactly one entry, `contents: read`.
- Triggers are exactly `push` (with `branches`) and `pull_request`.
- No `secrets.` reference, no `restore-keys`, no `--yes`, no `environment:`.
- No `${{` inside any `run:` value.
- Every `needs:` entry names a job defined earlier in the file.
- Jobs appear in generation order (topological).
- Every `run:` step has `shell: bash`.
